_doc: Every numeric comparison MUST resolve a key here. Missing key = test throws. Changing a tolerance requires approvedBy + approvedOn. This replaces the charter's rtol=1e-6 default ONLY where explicitly recorded.

hydraulics.afflux.note: Replaces a bare 0.08 absolute in engineConsistency.test.ts that had no recorded approval. At 0.08 m absolute on a typical 0.2 m afflux, ~40% relative drift could pass.
